description: This file defines a template specialization for formatting Protocol Buffer messages using the {fmt} library. It provides custom formatting for proto messages as text or JSON, depending on the format specifier.

classes.name: fmt::formatter<google::protobuf::Message>
classes.description: A template specialization for formatting protobuf messages with the {fmt} library, supporting text and JSON formats.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the format specifier from the format string, setting the format_ character.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the protobuf message into the output context as either text or JSON based on the format_ character.
